accounting.note: This tool audits individual receipts/quotes and produces no account PnL or inventory ledger. Graduated inventory remains unresolved because this CLI only decodes Pump curve trades; it does not fabricate an AMM sale.

limitations: A hypothetical quote is not a filled transaction or a profitability estimate.
Actual source and landing indexes come from canonical getBlock transaction arrays; logged indexes are retained only for comparison.
Missing signature, block, event, reserve continuity or migrated-pool execution is reported as unresolved coverage.
Existing OPEN/CLOSE rows without source signature and slot are not assigned guessed transaction positions.

migration.post_migration_decoder: not implemented in this bounded curve-fill audit; migrated positions remain unresolved and require separate authenticated PumpSwap/Raydium continuation coverage

placement_model.hypothetical_boundary: curve-state boundary after the selected full transaction group; no within-transaction insertion or exact hypothetical block index asserted
placement_model.seed_rule: sha256('ghost-placement-v1|' + stable intent identity + scenario label); no outcome or RPC result enters the seed

quote_method: Approved day_general integer quote helpers plus repaired Pump curve adapter; finite intent amount, protocol/creator fees and own reserve impact. Counterparty reactions after the hypothetical quote are not replayed.
scope: read-only post-exit Rust ghost intent/fill RPC audit; no order submission and no profitability replay
